limitations: No Part 9 domain is registered on this branch: every Gate N / SP-9.0 / SP-9.16 test fails by design until the fifteen sections are covered (dom1-3 branches).

The gate tests have only been run against the fixture and an empty registry; their cost with fifteen civ-backed domains (structure builds on 3 seeds x >= 5 configurations, reference/null/probe runs over each horizon, a 6 h civilisation composition) is not measured yet; social/content domains need a GPU slot (Qwen3-0.6B text path).

Reference isolation is a static AST check of the policy classes plus the construction rule (policies receive observations only); a reference could still smuggle world access through a helper function outside its class - reviewers must read references.
The exposure scanner looks for the reference's identifiers and its first three distinct tools in order; a paraphrased recipe in the objective text is not detected.

The dice scan is lexical/AST over the domain's declared sources (build/objective/evaluate files plus Domain.sources): draws in shared modules outside crucible/domains (commerce, economy, ...) are not scanned unless a domain lists them.

Autonomy requires population activity decisions other than pop.* / attention.* bookkeeping and every declared Actor active in null runs; whether an actor is genuinely deciding (not a scheduled physics process) depends on the events the domain author names.
Structure fingerprints ignore magnitudes by design: a configuration that differs from another only in a scarcity level (numbers) is not a new configuration even when the behaviour differs a lot.
